332: function Split-MultiChoiceValue([string]$Value) {
333:     if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)){ return @() }
334:     $out=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
335:     foreach($part in @($Value -split '\s*;\s*')){
336:         $v=[string]$part
337:         if(-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($v) -and -not $out.Contains($v.Trim())){[void]$out.Add($v.Trim())}
338:     }
339:     return @($out)

321: }

379: function Mark-CharacterChanged([string]$Value) {
380:     $c=Get-CurrentCharacter;if($null -eq $c){return}
381:     $c.Modified=(Get-Date).ToString('o');$moved=$false
382:     if($c.FileStatus -eq 'Blank' -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)){$c.FileStatus='In Progress';$script:ActiveStatus='In Progress';$moved=$true}
383:     Schedule-Save
384:     if($moved){Refresh-Navigation -KeepId $c.Id -NoRender}
385:     Update-NavLabels
386: }

388: function Set-MultiChoiceSelection([string]$Key,[string]$Option,[bool]$Selected) {
389:     if($script:Rendering){return}
390:     $c=Get-CurrentCharacter;if($null -eq $c){return}
391:     $items=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
392:     foreach($v in @(Split-MultiChoiceValue ([string]$c.Fields[$Key]))){[void]$items.Add([string]$v)}
393:     if($Selected){if(-not $items.Contains($Option)){[void]$items.Add($Option)}}else{[void]$items.Remove($Option)}
394:     $value=Join-MultiChoiceValue $items
395:     $c.Fields[$Key]=$value

914: function Check-ForRemoteUpdate([bool]$Silent=$false) {
915:     $manifest = Get-RemoteUpdateManifest
916:     $script:Settings.LastUpdateCheck = (Get-Date).ToString('o')
917:     Schedule-Save
918:     if ($null -eq $manifest) { if (-not $Silent) { Show-Info "The update feed could not be reached.`r`n`r`nInstalled version: $script:CurrentAppVersion" }; return }
919:     if ([string]$manifest.appId -ne $script:UpdateAppId) { if (-not $Silent) { Show-Error 'The update feed returned the wrong app channel.' }; return }
920:     $rv = [string]$manifest.version
921:     if (-not (Test-RemoteVersionNewer $rv $script:CurrentAppVersion)) { if (-not $Silent) { Show-Info "The Files is up to date.`r`n`r`nInstalled version: $script:CurrentAppVersion" }; return }
922: 
923:     if ($Silent) {
924:         # Startup checks install immediately with no confirmation dialog.
925:         Start-RemoteAppUpdate $manifest $true
926:         return
927:     }
928: 
929:     $msg = "A new The Files update is available.`r`n`r`nInstalled: $script:CurrentAppVersion`r`nAvailable: $rv"
930:     if ($manifest.notes) { $msg += "`r`n`r`n" + [string]$manifest.notes }
931:     $msg += "`r`n`r`nInstall it now?"
932:     if ((Show-Confirm $msg) -eq [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::Yes) { Start-RemoteAppUpdate $manifest $false }

1999:     for($n=0;$n -lt $count;$n++){

2013:             if($Direction -ge 0){$sheet.Left=$center-$grow}else{$sheet.Left=$center}
2014:             $sheet.Refresh();$book.Refresh();[System.Windows.Forms.Application]::DoEvents();Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $pause
2015:         }

2015:         }
2016:         $book.Controls.Remove($sheet);$sheet.Dispose();$book.Refresh()
2017:     }

2020: function Go-ToSection([string]$Target) {
2021:     if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Target) -or $Target -eq $script:CurrentSection){return}
2022:     $from=[array]::IndexOf($script:SectionOrder,$script:CurrentSection)
2023:     $to=[array]::IndexOf($script:SectionOrder,$Target)
2024:     if($from -lt 0 -or $to -lt 0){$script:CurrentSection=$Target;Render-CurrentCharacter;return}
2025:     Save-BrowseState
2026:     $direction=if($to -gt $from){1}else{-1}
2027:     $distance=[math]::Abs($to-$from)
2028:     Animate-BookPages $direction $distance $false
2029:     $script:CurrentSection=$Target
2030:     $script:Settings.LastSection=$Target
2031:     Render-CurrentCharacter
2032:     Schedule-Save
2033: }
